name: Spiking Graph Neural Network in Zig

mentions.name: Spiking Graph Neural Network in Zig
mentions.description: This project is a spiking graph neural network written in Zig, built to run on Brainchip Akida AKD1500 neuromorphic accelerators and Efinix Titanium Ti60 FPGAs. It is a self-taught effort drawing on foundational math such as spectral graph theory and graph convolutional network research.
mentions.source_excerpt: Teaching myself how to build a Spiking Graph Neural Network in Zig, to run on my Brainchip Akida AKD1500 neuromorphic accelerators (and Efinix Titanium Ti60 FPGAs).
